name: Frisbee Internet
summary: Adelaide dialup ISP (frisbee.net.au, 1996); defunct (PETERS, DAVID ALEXANDER (T/A FRISBEE INTERNET) (sole trader), ABN 76 804 981 725).

events.details: Defunct. The ISP was explicitly wound up by Feb 1998 after a stale site from Oct 1996 — the 2001/2002 dates describe the private system's page, not the ISP.

refs.label: ISP page still served Apr 1997 but already stale since Oct 1996
explicit retirement notice by 8 Feb 1998; site then ran as a private/hobby system through Nov 2001 and was a parked ad page by Jun 2008
ABN covered multiple ventures — confirms it can't date the ISP
